text.description: Sent as the user's next message in the conversation.

url.description: https URL, or a path the host knows how to open.

name.description: Tool the host is asked to run.

id.description: Suggested secret name: 2–32 characters, a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`. When it names an existing secret, the form changes that secret instead of creating one.

description.description: Suggested description of the secret, at most 2,000 characters.

name.description: Environment variable name, `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, unique ignoring case.

description.description: What the value is or where to find it, at most 2,000 characters.

variables.description: The variables the agent needs, in order.

secret.description: What the Happy Agent secret form starts with. The person may change every field before saving. It never holds a value: values are typed by the person.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

host.description: A host name or address, 1–253 characters. Or `*.` and a name, matching its subdomains.

pathPrefixes.description: Paths starting with `/`, each at most 256 characters. `/v1` admits `/v1` and `/v1/…`. Absent: any path.

targets.description: Requests the egress proxy applies the value to.

prefix.description: At most 32 printable ASCII characters sent before the value, such as `Bearer `.

headers.description: The headers the proxy sets, each to its prefix followed by the value. The form asks one value per header.

algorithm.description: How the proxy sends the value.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of an endpoint secret.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

hosts.description: Hosts the key signs for: names, addresses, or `*.name` patterns, each 1–253 characters.

knownHosts.description: Plain `known_hosts` lines, each at most 8,192 characters.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of an SSH key secret. The public key and fingerprint come from the key the person enters.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

server.description: One host name or address, 1–253 characters, never a pattern.

port.description: Integer port 1–65535, only when the server is not on 22 (SSH) or 443 (HTTPS).

knownHosts.description: Plain `known_hosts` lines, each at most 8,192 characters.

username.description: 1–128 characters. Absent: the token is sent as a bearer token.

method.description: How git authenticates. The form asks the key, password or token.

repos.description: Patterns such as `owner/repo` or `owner/*`, each at most 256 characters. Absent: every repository on the server.

operations.description: What the credential may do, each at most once. Only the `ssh_key` method may `sign`.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of a git credential.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

variables.description: Variable names, each `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, at most 128 characters and unique. The form asks one value per name.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of an environment secret.

secret.description: What the Happy Cloud secret form starts with, by secret type. It never holds a value: the form asks for each. Every field is a suggestion the person may change. A valid prefill is not necessarily a secret the cluster accepts; the cluster checks the saved form by its own rules.

plugin.description: The plugin whose page the host opens. Installing happens there; the tap installs nothing.

action.description: What happens when the user activates an interactive element. The renderer reports it; the host decides whether and how to run it, and may ask for confirmation or refuse. An action a host cannot run leaves its element disabled.

icon.description: Icon name. Each renderer maps every name to one glyph of its own icon set. An unknown name draws no icon.

box.summary: Lays out children in one direction.

role.description: What this box is. The platform decides its padding, surface, border and corner radius from the role.

gap.description: Relationship between children; the platform decides the distance.

equal.description: Row only: children share the width equally.

wrap.description: Row only: children may move to more lines. When false the children must fit on one line and shrink to do so.

divide.description: Hairline between children; `inset` starts at the second column of the children.

leading.description: On a list box and on each of its `item` rows: the widest leading element in the list. The platform reserves that column on every row so titles share an edge.

grow.description: Take the remaining space in a parent row.

grid.summary: A table: cells in row-major order, columns sized together.

density.description: `table`: a data table. `pairs`: a label/value list. The platform decides column and row spacing.

header.description: First row is a header row.

scroll.summary: A horizontally scrolling, snapping row of children.

shape.description: Shape of the cards' images. The platform decides card width, how many are visible, peeking and edge bleed from it.

switch.summary: Chooses one subtree by available width.

text.summary: Styled text from pre-parsed spans. Clients need no Markdown parser.

role.description: What the text is. The platform decides font, size, weight, line height, figure style and default colour.

tone.description: Overrides the role's default colour with a semantic one.

overflow.description: `wrap`: never cut. `clamp`: a few lines, platform decides how many. `truncate`: one line.

fixed.description: In a row: keeps its natural width and is never wrapped or truncated; its siblings give way.

align.description: Only for text that is not a grid cell; grid cells take their column's alignment.

icon.summary: One glyph from the icon set.

role.description: `leading`: starts a header or row. `inline`: sits in a line of text.

image.summary: A stored image. Always a file of the artifact, never a remote URL.

file.description: Path of the image inside the artifact.

width.description: Pixel width of the stored file.

thumbhash.description: Base64 ThumbHash, drawn until the file has loaded.

shape.description: Shape of the box the image fills, cropped and centred. The platform owns the exact ratio.

role.description: `figure`: a standalone image, height-capped by the platform. `tile`: a mosaic tile, square corners. `thumb`: a small leading thumbnail. `cover`: the top of a carousel card.

overlay.description: Text centred over a dimmed image (`+2`).

viewer.description: Tapping opens the host image viewer at this index of the group.

button.summary: A button. With an action the host cannot run, because it does not know or does not serve it, the button is drawn disabled with its label.

group.description: Buttons and presses sharing a group are single-choice: after one is activated it stays marked and the others are disabled.

press.summary: Makes its child tappable. With a missing or invalid action, or one the host cannot run, the child is drawn and is not tappable.

role.description: What is being pressed, so the platform can give a list row or a card its full-area highlight.

marker.summary: A step marker with the rail to the next step.

rail.description: Draw the rail down to the next marker.

plot.summary: A chart whose scale, ticks, labels and colours are already computed.

labels.description: Formatted text of each value, for tooltips and accessibility.

color.description: 1-based index into the shared chart palette in `theme.json`: `palette[(N - 1) % palette.length]`. `muted` is `chart.muted`. A colour name is `colors[name].ink`.

series.description: For a donut: one series, one colour per slice in `slices`.

legend.description: Legend rows, ready to draw. Absent when no legend is shown.

code.summary: A code block with a copy control.
